limitations: The shell prompt is rendered on xterm canvas and remains diagnostic-only; local PTY shell probes prove interactivity separately.
This local startup measurement does not measure a remote SSH host's first prompt.

This binary is a pnpm tauri build --debug artifact with an embedded frontend and was measured with no Vite dev server running. A binary produced by a bare cargo build instead loads build.devUrl, renders a blank window with no readiness at all, and fails closed with a diagnostic pointing at pnpm dev:frontend; the two are not interchangeable, so the measured sha256 must be checked before citing this file.
Human physical keyboard, real macOS IME, Option/dead key, Windows/Pageant, and serial hardware acceptance remain unverified.

source.note: Debug evidence cannot be validated against the artifact on disk, because pnpm verify relinks target/debug/terminal as a bare cargo build. This content fingerprint of the sources these scenarios exercise is what makes a stale measurement detectable.

note: Fresh spawn-to-ready run on the current-source instrumented debug binary after the serial lifecycle and platform classification fixes. The run includes the macOS AX helper build cost.
